He said to them, strive to enter through the narrow door.
For many I tell you, will try to enter and we'll not be able.

When you look at somebody like me, will you be able to say,
blessed is the one who comes in the name of the Lord to me or not?
That will tell you a whole lot about the kind of person that you are and whether or not the Holy Spirit truly lives in you.
